supplementary_databases.amsterdam: not_performed: admissions.location identifies IC/MC, not cardiac-surgical unit; specialty is not an ICU unit and is not substituted
supplementary_databases.sicdb: not_performed: source unit dictionary distinguishes care intensity, not cardiac-surgical ICU; surgical diagnosis/admission type is not a unit and is not substituted

S2.name: Restrict to source-confirmed sepsis population
S2.mimic: At least one existing mimiciv_derived.sepsis3 row with sepsis3=true for index stay, without imposing a new onset-time window
S2.mimic_absence: Existing derived table contains positive rows only. No matching row is not source-confirmed non-sepsis; report as not listed in positive-derived table and exclude from the restriction. Null/false rows, if present, remain separately classified.
S2.eicu: Case-insensitive substring sepsis in nonempty public.patient.apacheadmissiondx; source field is APACHE admission diagnosis
S2.eicu_missing: Null/empty/unknown diagnosis is unascertainable; nonempty non-sepsis diagnosis is recorded other APACHE diagnosis, not a claim that infection is absent

scope: Main endpoint overall and five original-known dose strata; deep missed hypotension arterial<55 overall and >1.0; arterial<65 given cuff>=65 overall and >1.0. Add layer arterial<65 prevalence, counts, source ascertainment, flow checks. No additional tests, models, pooled estimates, outcomes, or phenotype analyses.
overall: All selected pairs including unknown dose
known_dose: Original phase1 range-checked known doses; no recovery

bootstrap.unit: patient within selected database and sensitivity population
bootstrap.implementation: Phase1 summarize and phase2 ratio_engine resampling mechanics retained: sorted patient index, multinomial whole-patient weights in batches of50, no pair resampling
bootstrap.boundary: Keep event and denominator counts; mark degenerate zero/all-event CI as boundary_not_informative; empty denominator not_estimable
bootstrap.precision: denominator<30 or CI width>0.30 marked insufficient, never combine/delete

audit: 20 patients per main database, deterministically sampled over joint S1/S2 states. Independently query source careunit and diagnosis/Sepsis-3 rows with separate SQL; row-level records retained in _restricted.
earlier_work: Phase2 baseline/range/pair audits reused for unchanged variables; no claim of new full extraction verification.
